value.visualThesis: A long-scroll, SaaS-style B2B agency page that alternates a dark violet photographic hero, predominantly light neutral surfaces with faint lavender tints, one photographic proof band and dark anchor bands at the page end. Identity is carried by a violet pill button/badge system, a three-family type stack (rounded-geometric display, tracked grotesque H2, humanist body with capitalize transforms), an unusually tall asymmetric card collection for the six services, narrative splits with floating descriptive chips, a pill-accordion FAQ, and a compact newsletter band leading into a black contact banner and dense dark footer. For RankForge Kenya, all reference branding and content are replaced with Nairobi SEO-growth agency content; violet accent roles are preserved as the brand's primary accent color system.

signatureTraits.description: Full-bleed ~1.07-viewport hero (evidence region-2) with photographic office/collaboration background under a dark violet wash, carrying the 60px-class display headline and one violet pill CTA. Implementation: darkened image with rgb(48,32,64)-family overlay, white display headline, single pill CTA 'Request an SEO Consultation' plus secondary text CTA.

Header bar (~143px desktop) with centered inline navigation strip (Poppins-class 15px/600 capitalize links) and a distinct violet pill CTA at the header right. Mobile collapses to a compact menu keeping the pill CTA reachable.

Near-full-height light editorial split: large portrait-orientation photo in a soft lavender circular/blob mask on the left, dense multi-bullet copy on the right, titled with a violet pill badge + tracked H2. For RankForge: portrait of a practitioner at work on SEO analysis.

The tallest region (~1.86 viewport ratios) holds RankForge's six services as an asymmetric card collection: a 4-across icon-chip card row, a 2-across wide-card row, then a further row — equal white rounded cards with small violet pill per-card actions. No card invented beyond the six verified services; wide cards carry the two deepest services (SEO Strategy, SEO Audits).

Two sequential narrative splits pairing imagery with copy plus small floating cards. Because business facts prohibit invented statistics, chips carry descriptive labels (e.g. 'Technical SEO', 'Local SEO — Nairobi', 'Content Strategy') rather than metrics. First split right-aligned image, second left-aligned image, alternating.

Light FAQ band with left flat-illustration montage and right-stacked violet pill-shaped accordion rows: first item expanded in dark text, remaining items as saturated violet pills with trailing chevron icons.

Full-bleed office photograph band with overlaid white rounded cards and one dark accent card on the left. Adapted for RankForge into a photo-backed 'problems we solve' / closing-conversion band using only verified customer problems — no invented testimonials, ratings or metrics.

Compact ~0.4-viewport newsletter band with inline name/email fields, then a ~0.8-viewport dark contact/footer region beginning with a black full-width conversion banner ('Ready to make organic search work harder for your business?' + 'Talk to RankForge' pill) and dense multi-column dark footer.

fidelityPriorities: 1. Page silhouette and surface sequence (dark hero → light bands → photo mass → dark anchors) — the strongest identity signal.
2. First-viewport composition: darkened photo hero, display headline scale, violet pill CTA.
3. Violet pill button/badge system with trailing glyphs — applied to every action.
4. Region topology and height strategy, including the ~1.86-ratio services collection.
5. Typography relationships: three-family stack, capitalize heading voice, display/body contrast.
6. Photography grammar: darkened collaborative-office backgrounds, masked portrait, medium posed-person shots.
7. Responsive transformations: full stacking without content removal, masked portrait scaling, nav collapse.
8. Motion language: scroll reveals with static composition (per Adaptation Contract).

globalGrid.containerLogic: Full-bleed surface bands with an inner 1200px max-width content container, 40px desktop / 20px mobile gutters. Split regions use two-column grids; card regions use 4-col and 2-col rows inside the same container; dark banner and footer bands are full-bleed surfaces with container-aligned content. No horizontal overflow at any breakpoint.

value.spacingRhythm: Generous editorial rhythm: normal sections ~96–112px vertical padding, tight bands (newsletter, logo strip) ~56–64px, hero full-viewport height. Consistent ~24–32px internal gaps between heading badge, heading, body and CTAs; 16–24px gaps in card grids; footer uses dense 48px column gutters. Preserve the intentional contrast between the airy hero/about and the compressed newsletter band.

typographyRoles.description: Figtree 700, ~60px/78px desktop scaling to ~34px mobile, capitalize, white on dark hero, max ~14 words over 2–3 lines.
Montserrat 700, 40px/48px desktop, 0.8px letter-spacing, capitalize, preceded by small violet pill badge label; scales to ~28px mobile.
Figtree 700, ~28–32px desktop, used for card titles and narrative sub-headings, creating a compressed hierarchy below H2.
Poppins 400, 16px/1.4, rgb(55,65,81), max measure ~65ch; bullet lists in about split use 1.5 line-height.
Poppins 600, 15px, capitalize, used for nav links, pill CTA labels and badge labels.
Poppins 400/500, 14px, text-on-dark with muted variants for footer columns and legal line.

colorRoles.description: Light neutral #F9FAFB/#F0F0F0 with occasional faint lavender tints #F0E0FF carries the majority of the page; do not flood with brand violet.
Saturated violet #8E2DE2 (with deeper #4E2FDA for gradients/variants) is reserved for CTAs, badges, FAQ pills, icon chips — low-to-mid frequency, attention-directing only.
Dark violet-washed hero and near-black #101010 contact banner frame the page top and bottom, echoing the reference mass balance.
Near-black headings, #374151 body, #6B7280 metadata; light-on-dark equivalents in hero, banner and footer.

value.surfaceLanguage: Flat, friendly SaaS surfaces: white rounded cards (16px radius) on light bands, saturated violet pill fills for actions, soft lavender blob/circular mask for the about portrait, dark gradient wash over photographic hero and testimonial-band imagery, near-black full-bleed banner before the footer. Minimal shadows (subtle card elevation only), no glass, no textures, no gradient buttons beyond subtle violet depth.
value.headerNavigation: Static (non-sticky is acceptable; sticky with solid light background is allowed on scroll) ~143px desktop header: logo left, centered inline nav strip of capitalize Poppins 600 links (Home, Services, About, Process, FAQ, Contact), violet pill CTA ('Request an SEO Consultation' shortened, e.g. 'Free Consultation') at the right. Mobile: hamburger opening a compact panel with stacked links and the pill CTA kept visible; header compresses to ~64–72px.

homepageFirstViewport.summary: Header plus a full-bleed dark photographic hero occupying ~1.07 viewport height total. Background: candid collaborative office/workplace photograph under a dark violet wash (rgba(48,32,64,~0.82)) ensuring white text contrast. Content block left-aligned inside the 1200px container: hero headline 'Get found when your customers are already searching.' (Figtree-class 60px/700, capitalize, 2–3 lines), supporting copy on technical SEO, content strategy and focused search execution (~40–60 words, max 560px), then a violet pill primary CTA 'Request an SEO Consultation' with arrow glyph and a secondary text CTA 'Explore Our Services'. Some of the next light band may peek at very tall viewports; bottom of hero anchors with dark mass.

homepageRegions.purpose: Header, centered inline nav with violet pill CTA, and full-bleed dark violet-washed photo hero with display headline, supporting copy and primary/secondary CTAs.

About/approach editorial split: portrait-orientation practitioner photo in soft lavender blob mask on the left, violet pill badge + H2 ('SEO without the noise.' class) and dense multi-bullet copy on the right (expertise, philosophy, principles).

Light strip with centered Montserrat heading and a horizontal row of ~5 desaturated keyword/sector badges (e.g. 'Ecommerce', 'Hospitality & Travel', 'B2B', 'Professional Services', 'Local Nairobi') at reduced visual weight, since inventing client logos is prohibited.

The tall commercial core: violet badge + H2 introducing the six services as an asymmetric card collection — 4-across icon-chip cards (Technical SEO, Local SEO, SEO Content Strategy, Ecommerce SEO), a 2-across wide-card row (SEO Strategy, SEO Audits with longer descriptions), each card white/rounded with icon chip, title, short body and small violet pill action.

Right-aligned image narrative split: medium shot of a practitioner at work with floating descriptive chips (e.g. 'Technical SEO', 'Local SEO — Nairobi'); copy describes the diagnose→prioritise focus without invented metrics.

Left-aligned image narrative split introducing the four-stage process (01 Diagnose, 02 Prioritise, 03 Execute, 04 Improve) with supporting imagery/illustration montage and floating chips labelled with stage names.

Light FAQ band: flat-illustration montage on the left, stacked violet pill accordion rows on the right (first expanded in dark text, rest as saturated violet pills with chevrons) answering SEO service questions using only verified capability facts.

Full-bleed darkened office photograph band with overlaid white rounded cards listing verified customer problems (little qualified traffic, competitors ranking above, SEO without strategy, technical issues) and one dark accent card leading into conversion; explicitly adapted from the reference testimonial treatment with zero invented testimonials/ratings.
Compact light newsletter band with inline name and email fields plus violet pill submit, framed tightly between the photo band and dark footer.

Dark anchor region: near-black full-width conversion banner ('Ready to make organic search work harder for your business?' + 'Talk to RankForge' pill), then dense dark multi-column footer with contact email hello@rankforgekenya.example, Nairobi/Kenya service-area note, nav links and legal line.

imageSystem.photographyGrammar: Business-context documentary-commercial photography, not product display: candid collaborative office scenes darkened for overlaid UI (hero, photo band); one portrait-orientation medium shot of a person at a device inside a soft lavender blob mask (about); medium lightly-posed single-person shots against clean light or lavender backgrounds in narrative splits; flat colorful illustration montages (not photography) beside FAQ and within process imagery. One to two people per frame, gaze toward task or camera, warm-neutral color with moderate contrast, clean restrained backgrounds leaving text-safe negative space. Avoid macro product shots, dramatic cinematic lighting and desaturated fashion-editorial grading.

imageRoles.purpose: Full-bleed candid Kenyan office/collaboration scene (people at laptops) under dark violet wash, providing negative space for headline and CTA on the left.
Portrait-orientation medium shot of a single SEO practitioner at work, displayed inside a soft lavender circular/blob mask on a light surface.
Small square flat icon/illustration chips (up to 6) representing each verified service, used atop service cards.
Medium lightly-posed shot of a person working on search analytics, clean light background, right-aligned in split with floating descriptive chips.
Left-aligned photo/illustration montage supporting the four-stage process, clean background, chip-safe negative space.
Flat colorful illustration montage (~3 square figures) beside the FAQ accordion, non-photographic.
Full-bleed darker-graded office photograph as backdrop for overlaid problem/conversion cards on the left half.

motionGrammar: Scroll-triggered reveal transitions on sections and cards (fade + small upward translate, 400–600ms, ease-out), substituting reference parallax per the Adaptation Contract; macro composition stays static.
Floating descriptive chips in narrative splits receive a subtle depth cue (slower/lower-amplitude reveal or gentle hover float) instead of parallax drift.
Violet pill buttons transition color/shadow on hover (~200ms); FAQ accordion rows expand/collapse smoothly (~300ms) with chevron rotation.
Reduced motion: all reveals and floats collapse to instant/opacity-only states; content, focus and state feedback fully preserved.
No structural motion: no horizontal scroll, no section reordering; topology stable under scroll.
responsiveContract: 375px mobile retains all sections and nav items — everything reflows to single-column stacking, nothing hidden.
Header compresses (~64–72px), centered nav collapses to a hamburger panel; violet pill CTA stays reachable.
Hero: headline scales to ~34px, copy and CTAs stack; background image crops center-left preserving text-safe area; overlay retained.
4-across and 2-across card rows stack to single column, each card retaining icon chip and pill action.
Splits (about, narratives, FAQ) stack image above/below copy; masked portrait scales within its mask.
Photo band keeps overlaid cards, stacked; card backgrounds darken for readability over cropped imagery.
Newsletter fields stack vertically; footer columns collapse to stacked groups with consistent spacing.
No horizontal overflow; no clipped critical content at any breakpoint.
innerPageVocabulary: EDITORIAL_SPLIT — image + copy two-column page opener for About/Services; reuse masked-portrait or narrative-photo treatment.
NARROW_NARRATIVE — 720px measure single-column manifesto/principles content with pill badge + H2.
PROCESS_SEQUENCE — numbered 01–04 stage list with icon chips, extending the narrative-split chip language.
CARD_GRID — the 4-across/2-across asymmetric card rows reused for full service detail listings.
QUIET_CTA — compact light band with badge + H2 + violet pill CTA before the dark contact banner.
CONTACT_SPLIT — form (verified field set: Name, Company, Email, Phone, Website, help-topic select, Message) beside illustration montage, feeding the central WAZIBIZ Form Service.
antiFallbackRules: Do not replace the asymmetric 4/2 card collection with uniform equal card grids.
Do not drop the lavender blob mask on the about portrait or substitute a plain rectangle.
Do not invent testimonials, star ratings, metrics or client logos — the reference's testimonial cards become verified problem-statement cards.
Do not center all headings; preserve left-aligned badge+H2 pattern except the credibility strip.
Do not add glass, textures, gradient meshes or heavy shadows absent from the reference.
Do not replace pill buttons with square or outlined ghost buttons; the violet pill system with trailing glyphs is systemic.
Do not reduce the services region to a compact 3-card row; preserve the tall multi-row collection.
Do not apply generic fade-up to every element uniformly; follow the motion grammar hierarchy.
Do not copy reference copy, branding, logos, 'Ver Mais' labels or photography in any form.
accessibilityAdaptations: All text over photographic backgrounds carries a sufficient dark overlay to meet WCAG AA contrast.
Visible focus rings (violet, offset) on all links, pills, form fields and accordion triggers.
Accordion rows are real buttons with aria-expanded/aria-controls; state is not hover-only.
prefers-reduced-motion removes reveals/floats while preserving all content and feedback.
Form labels explicitly associated with fields; select options use verified service list; visitor email validated and used as Reply-To only.
Mobile body text ≥16px; tap targets ≥44px including pills and nav links.
declaredLimitations: Reference heavy parallax is unsupported and replaced by static composition plus reduced reveal/depth cues per the accepted Adaptation Contract (heavy_parallax).
Reference stat/metric chips ('45.80%' style) cannot be reproduced because business facts prohibit invented statistics; chips carry descriptive labels instead.
Reference client-logo strip cannot be reproduced without inventing customers; the strip is adapted to desaturated sector/keyword badges at identical visual weight.
Reference testimonial cards cannot be reproduced without invented reviews; the photo-backed band carries verified customer-problem statements and a conversion card.
Exact reference fonts used as Google-available equivalents (Figtree, Montserrat, Poppins) with matching weights and transforms.
No office address or team facts are verified, so the footer omits a physical address and team roster beyond city/country service-area wording.
Exact reference timing/easing values were unmeasured; motion durations are best-practice approximations within the reduced-motion contract.
